purpose: Local, deterministic agreement computation between frozen Candidate B (Cerebras qwen-3.8-27b) and frozen Candidate E (NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super 120B A12B) across the FULL 72-case Phase-7 benchmark (development + validation + all held-out splits). Computed entirely offline from saved predictions - never asked either provider to calculate agreement.
interpretation: Cohen's kappa 0.90 is 'almost perfect' agreement by the standard Landis & Koch scale - a strong, real corroboration signal between two architecturally and provider-independent evaluators, not identical, not merged.
candidate_b_predictions_source: gold for all cases except the 2 known supplement exceptions (P7V2-BT3-U, P7V2-MI4-S), taken directly from artifacts/v2/phase7_heldout_supplement_results.json's recorded per-case predictions.
